text_block_list.text:
A few days after the Satsuki Sho—Agnes 
Tachyon suddenly held a press conference 
to announce an "indefinite suspension" of 
her racing career.

Agnes Tachyon missed the Satsuki Sho, but 
remains the favorite for the remaining two 
crowns, so why...? The press conference 
concluded with few answers given.

After winning the Satsuki Sho with a 
breathtaking performance, the Triple Crown 
was well within Agnes Tachyon's sights—so 
why...? The press conference concluded 
with few answers given.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, to everyone's disbelief, Agnes 
Tachyon offered to become Manhattan Cafe's 
"advisor."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon's true intentions remain 
unknown. Yet Manhattan Cafe accepted her, 
and together they began walking the path 
toward the Classics.
